summary: Added 'autonomous' consult mode to bench-heldout.js (valid modes list + PREAMBLE entry: MCP available, graph read-only, no forced search). Ran 10 trials each for task-transcript and locale-sum. Results: task-transcript on-autonomous 0/10 (0%) vs on-search 7/8 (88%), on-gated 2/25 (8%), off 0/20 (0%). locale-sum on-autonomous 0/10 (0%) vs on-search 6/6 (100%), on-gated 7/12 (58%), off 5/10 (50%). Autonomous arm (MCP available but no search instruction) scores 0% on both candidates — confirming the KB consult instruction is the active ingredient, not mere MCP availability.
